title: Generic groundwater application orchestration

prerequisite.current_blocker: repository-wide GitHub Actions runner queue; exact-head owner and F-VQ120 reruns queued

reconcile_findings: F-GC39 defines the internal prepared-solve coupling-service ownership contract but intentionally has production_delta NONE and no production language/location decision.
F-GC42 composes F-GC39 convergence with F-GC41 publication but remains qualification support only.
F-GC44-F-GC47 prove real SWAP plus live MODFLOW application compositions through qualification-only C bridges.
modflow6_prepared_solve_session.py is a production MODFLOW/XMI backend and explicitly does not own predictor/corrector science.
mod_groundwater_multiswap_coupler is production Fortran but targets groundwater_preparable_exchange_service_t, not the live MODFLOW prepared-solve session.
The existing abstract groundwater exchange service and live xmipy prepared-solve backend are separate execution worlds; no canonical generic application service currently bridges them.
F-GC48 is intended to become the generic topology authority and must be canonical before F-GC49 production code consumes it.
design_decisions: Place generic coupling-window orchestration in an internal SWAP5-MODFLOW application service below iMOD Coupler.
Keep modflow6_prepared_solve_session.py as the only owner of XMI pointers and MODFLOW prepare_solve/solve/finalize_solve/finalize_time_step mechanics.
Keep real SWAP state/trial/rollback/commit ownership in Fortran FMR/kernel participants; expose only a narrow production participant bridge to the application service.
Do not reimplement F-GC40 affine tile-to-cell reduction or F-GC34 API mapping in Python. Materialize cell terms and routing through Fortran production contracts.
Consume one immutable F-GC48 topology snapshot for the full coupling window.
Run one prepared MODFLOW solve per window, iterating all topology cells together.
For every coupling iteration route each MODFLOW cell head only to the SWAP tiles owned by that cell; nonfinal SWAP candidates are discarded while MODFLOW X evolves and XOLD remains fixed.
Coupled convergence is conjunctive across MODFLOW and every active cell-level interface residual.
After finalize_solve, preflight every final SWAP candidate, every prepared ledger and MODFLOW timestep readiness before the first irreversible publication.

Publication order remains one MODFLOW finalize_time_step, then deterministic SWAP commits, then deterministic ledger commits; failures after the first publication point are durability/restart class, not rollback-safe retry.

proposed_components.name: groundwater_application_plan
proposed_components.responsibility: Consume admitted F-GC48 topology plus tile predictor responses and materialize canonical per-cell F-GC40 responses, F-GC33 linear terms, F-GC34 API bindings and tile-to-cell routing without mutation.

proposed_components.name: production_fmr_groundwater_participant_bridge
proposed_components.language: Fortran C ABI plus thin Python client
proposed_components.responsibility: Expose capture-origin, predictor-response, corrector-from-origin, discard, publication-ready and commit over production FMR participants without exposing kernel internals.

proposed_components.name: modflow6_groundwater_application_service
proposed_components.responsibility: Own only generic coupling-window orchestration; consume application plan, production SWAP participant client and Modflow6PreparedSolveSession. Own no XMI arrays directly and no SWAP state.

proposed_components.name: modflow6_prepared_solve_session
proposed_components.responsibility: Remain sole live MODFLOW/XMI prepared-solve backend.

exclusions: production implementation before F-GC48 canonical admission
Python reimplementation of F-GC40 or F-GC34
admission_shape: generic service reproduces F-GC44 1:1, F-GC45 N:1, F-GC46 multi-cell and F-GC47 mixed topology through one production orchestration path
same-origin SWAP candidate identity retained through final publication
fixed accepted MODFLOW XOLD across all coupling iterations
no topology-specific branches in application service
independent verifier proves F-GC40/F-GC34 authority is not duplicated
next_permitted_action: Wait only for F-GC48 canonical admission. Then rebase/reconcile this design against the admitted topology API, implement the Fortran application-plan materializer first, qualify it, then add the narrow production participant bridge and generic Python application service.
